other_failure_modes.name: Target Encoding Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Target encoding is precomputed out-of-fold on the full training data prior to the main cross-validation loop. Because the main CV loop uses the exact same folds, the training folds will contain target-encoded features computed using the validation fold's targets, leading to massive target leakage and overly optimistic validation scores.

other_failure_modes.name: Feature Aggregation Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Group-by aggregations (e.g., means and standard deviations of numerical features grouped by categorical features) are computed on the entire training set before cross-validation. This leaks the marginal distribution of features from the validation set into the training set.

other_failure_modes.name: Ensemble Evaluation Overfitting
other_failure_modes.description: The blending weights for the ensemble are optimized on the full set of out-of-fold predictions, and the final validation score is reported on those exact same predictions. This lacks an independent holdout set for the ensemble layer, resulting in an overfitted and optimistic ensemble score.

summary: The solution implements a strong pipeline with appropriate models, an appropriate metric, and extensive feature engineering. However, it suffers from critical target leakage because out-of-fold target encodings are computed globally before the main cross-validation loop (using the same fold structures), causing validation target data to leak into the training features. Additionally, the final ensemble score is evaluated on the same predictions used to optimize the blending weights.
